## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation

## How was it tested?

<!-- Commands you ran and what you checked by hand. Attach screenshots from a synthetic session for visual changes. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `node --test 'test/*.test.mjs'` passes.
- [ ] `node --check` passes on `src/*.mjs` and `public/*.mjs`.
- [ ] No new dependencies.
- [ ] Nothing new reaches the browser that could contain prompts, outputs or full paths.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an `[Unreleased]` entry for user-visible changes (or not applicable for a typo/internal-only change).
- [ ] Any known limitations or untested platforms are described above.
